abilities.critical_failure: The creature takes double damage and is exposed to leechlichen. The results of its saving throw against the leechlichen are treated as one step worse.
abilities.failure: The creature takes full damage and is exposed to leechlichen.
abilities.name: Lurching Lichen
abilities.trigger: Three or more creatures not infected with leechlichen enter the area of the hazard; Effect The mass of lichen lurches forward, taking up one 5-foot square and forming a beast-like shape. The hazard rolls initiative.

hazard.description: A mass of petrified lichen takes the shape of a beast and lurches forward.
hazard.disable: DC 33 Survival or Thievery (master) to scrape away lichen without being exposed, or DC 36 Medicine or Nature (expert) to concoct a natural remedy and weaken the hazard; four total successes are required to disable it
hazard.name: Lichen Monstrosity
hazard.reset: The trap resets over the course of an hour.
hazard.routine: (3 actions) The lichen monstrosity uses 3 actions to move, traveling up to 30 feet with each action and dealing 2d10+10 bludgeoning damage. Each creature in its path must attempt a DC 31 Reflex save.
hazard.text: Each successful check to disable this hazard reduces its movement by 30 feet, and the fourth success disables it completely.

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
